Inside, the cabin offers comfort and convenience with its 8-way power driver seat that includes power lumbar adjustment and power recline, allowing you to find your ideal driving position. The dual-zone automatic temperature control ensures both driver and passenger can set their preferred comfort levels independently. The fold-down rear center armrest with two cupholders makes accommodating passengers more pleasant, while the split-folding rear seat provides flexibility when you need to transport larger items.  Entertainment and connectivity are handled by the SYNC 3 system, which delivers intuitive control over your audio, phone, and vehicle functions. With SiriusXM satellite radio and standard AM/FM capability, you'll have access to your favorite programming wherever the road takes you. The 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot keeps you connected on the go, and FordPass Connect brings vehicle management to your smartphone. The sport steering wheel gives you responsive control, while the telescoping tilt adjustment ensures you find your ideal driving position. The NissanConnect system pairs seamlessly with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected to navigation and entertainment. Blind Spot Warning helps protect you on busy roads, while rear parking sensors make backing up easier. The CVT with Xtronic transmission provides smooth acceleration and responsive performance for everyday driving.  Practical touches make ownership easier. The SR floor mats, trunk mat, and hideaway nets protect your interior, while the trunk organizer tray keeps your cargo organized. description: This 2014 Toyota Tacoma Base V6 delivers dependable capability with practical features designed for work and adventure. With its proven 4.0L V6 engine paired with a 5-Speed Automatic transmission and 4WD system, this truck handles diverse terrain and towing demands with confidence.  - 4X4/All Wheel Drive - Backup Camera - Bluetooth connectivity - SR5 Package with SR5 Badging and Chrome Grille Surround & Rear Bumper - Towing Package with Class IV Hitch and HD Battery - Power Outside Mirrors with Remote Keyless Entry - Cruise Control - Front Fog Lamps - Sliding Rear Window with Privacy Glass - Leather-Wrapped Steering Wheel & Shift Knob - Driver Lumbar Support - Entune Audio Plus with 6.1" Touch-Screen Display - AM/FM Stereo with CD Player and SiriusXM Satellite Radio capability - Dual Front and Side Impact Airbags with Anti-Whiplash Protection - Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control  The truck's gray exterior presents a professional appearance that suits both job sites and everyday driving. Its spacious cab features front bucket seats with a center armrest, cloth trim, and an overhead console that keeps essentials within reach. The Entune Audio Plus system with its 6.1-inch touch screen, USB port, and Bluetooth hands-free capability keeps you connected safely while driving. Steering wheel audio controls allow you to manage entertainment and calls without taking your hands off the wheel.  Safety features include electronic stability control, traction control, dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, anti-whiplash front head restraints, and low tire pressure warning. The independent front suspension and front anti-roll bar provide stability whether you're navigating city streets or rough terrain.  Fuel economy runs at an estimated 16 MPG city and 21 MPG highway, offering reasonable efficiency for a V6 truck of this capability. The 3.727 axle ratio supports both daily driving and towing operations. With its Class IV hitch, transmission oil cooler, and supplemental oil cooler, the towing package ensures proper cooling and performance under load.
